superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorov zajednički maksimum čestica: PM10 sada dostiže 41 µg/m³ na Stojčinom brdu, dok PM2.5 dostiže 38 µg/m³ na Zelenom brdu. Maksimum NO2 sada je 24 µg/m³ kod Franše d’Eperea, ali ovi stanični maksimumi ne dokazuju kretanje zagađenja između naselja. [F4][F8][F6][F5][F7][F9]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's shared particle peak: PM10 now reaches 41 µg/m³ at Stojčino brdo, while PM2.5 reaches 38 µg/m³ at Zeleno brdo [F4][F8]. The NO2 maximum is now 24 µg/m³ at Franše d’Epere, but these station maxima do not establish pollution moving between neighborhoods [F6][F5][F7][F9].
